summary.name: QuestStudio
summary.one_liner: QuestStudio is an AI creative studio for generating and editing images, short promo videos, voiceovers and music in one place, with guided workflows and brand asset storage.
keywords: image and video in one place
use_cases: Create product images from a description or reference photo
Make short silent promo or product reveal videos
Generate voiceovers and music for a video
Keep brand kits and campaign briefs together for ads
Explore sample projects before starting your own
summary.what_it_does: QuestStudio is a browser-based studio for AI image, video, voice and music generation. Users describe a result, optionally add reference images, review the model, format and credit estimate, then generate. Guided workflows prepare a starting point, while full model selection and advanced controls are available in the Labs. Results can be refined, saved and downloaded, and variations can start from a saved result. Ad Studio stores briefs, brand kits and campaigns, and users can upload their own product and brand assets. All generation draws from one credit balance shared across images, video and audio.
notable: Free account includes five FLUX Schnell images total, no card required
Images, video, voice and music share one credit balance; cost shown in the Lab before generating
Ad Studio for brand kits, briefs and campaigns
Guided workflows with option to switch to full model selection in the Labs
caveats: Other models and tools require an eligible trial or paid allowance; only five FLUX Schnell images are free
Trial requires a card: 7 days, 100 credits, then from $14.99/month unless canceled
Generated details, packaging and text should be reviewed before use in a campaign
